summary: Levenshtein used byte lengths to size and index distance arrays while iterating over characters. For levenshtein("abc", "öঙ香"), the returned byte-indexed slot remains zero instead of the correct distance 3. The fix consistently uses character counts for empty-input results, array sizing, initialization, and the final index. Reversing only the Levenshtein function restores the original implementation while preserving the regression test added by the fix. No tests were run.
